fetal_conditions.description: Fetus developing within normal parameters. Appropriate growth velocity, normal amniotic fluid volume, normal umbilical artery Doppler.
fetal_conditions.imaging_features: Normal biometry, appropriate for gestational age, no structural abnormalities
fetal_conditions.recommendations: Continue routine prenatal care, repeat ultrasound in 4 weeks

fetal_conditions.description: Mild growth restriction with abdominal circumference or estimated fetal weight 10th-20th percentile.
fetal_conditions.imaging_features: Decreased AC, normal FL, cerebroplacental ratio >1.0, normal umbilical artery
fetal_conditions.recommendations: Doppler studies, close monitoring, repeat ultrasound in 2 weeks

fetal_conditions.condition: Fetal Growth Restriction (FGR) - Moderate to Severe
fetal_conditions.description: Significant growth restriction with EFW <10th percentile, concerning Doppler indices.
fetal_conditions.imaging_features: Markedly decreased AC, FL <10th percentile, abnormal cerebroplacental ratio, elevated S/D ratio in umbilical artery
fetal_conditions.maternal_factors: Preeclampsia, severe hypertension, placental insufficiency, maternal diabetes
fetal_conditions.recommendations: Immediate hospitalization, frequent monitoring (2-3 times per week), consider delivery if >34 weeks

fetal_conditions.description: Excessive fetal growth with EFW >90th percentile for gestational age.
fetal_conditions.iugr_risk: Not IUGR but increased perinatal complications
fetal_conditions.imaging_features: Large AC and FL biometry, increased subcutaneous fat
fetal_conditions.maternal_factors: Maternal diabetes, obesity, excessive weight gain
fetal_conditions.recommendations: Glucose tolerance testing, dietary counseling, assess for gestational diabetes

fetal_conditions.description: Excess amniotic fluid volume (AFI >25 cm or deepest pocket >10 cm).
fetal_conditions.iugr_risk: Associated with various conditions including FGR
fetal_conditions.imaging_features: Large amniotic fluid pockets, fetus may appear 'floating'
fetal_conditions.maternal_factors: Maternal diabetes, Rh incompatibility, multiple pregnancy
fetal_conditions.recommendations: Detailed fetal anatomy survey, monitor for preterm labor, serial ultrasounds monthly

fetal_conditions.description: Decreased amniotic fluid volume (AFI <5 cm or deepest pocket <2 cm).
fetal_conditions.iugr_risk: High, especially if associated with growth restriction
fetal_conditions.imaging_features: Minimal amniotic fluid, fetus may appear crowded
fetal_conditions.maternal_factors: Preeclampsia, chronic hypertension, placental insufficiency, fetal anomaly
fetal_conditions.recommendations: Check maternal blood pressure, fetal renal assessment, frequent monitoring

fetal_conditions.description: Decreased placental perfusion and function affecting fetal growth and oxygenation.
fetal_conditions.imaging_features: FGR pattern, abnormal Doppler - reversed end-diastolic flow in umbilical artery, increased pulsatility
fetal_conditions.maternal_factors: Severe preeclampsia, maternal hypertension, placental abruption history
fetal_conditions.recommendations: URGENT: Fetal monitoring, consider delivery timing, neonatal team notification

fetal_conditions.description: Single umbilical artery, true knot, cord around neck affecting fetal perfusion.
fetal_conditions.imaging_features: Only one artery visible in cord, color Doppler shows cord entanglement, abnormal amniotic fluid
fetal_conditions.recommendations: Frequent Doppler monitoring, assess fetal growth, consider delivery before term if deterioration

maternal_conditions.effect_on_fetus: Decreases placental perfusion, leading to FGR and oligohydramnios
maternal_conditions.severity_impact: Mild HTN (140-160): low risk; Severe HTN (>180): high FGR risk
maternal_conditions.management: Blood pressure monitoring, antihypertensive therapy, frequent ultrasounds

maternal_conditions.effect_on_fetus: Severe placental dysfunction, high risk of FGR and sudden fetal death
maternal_conditions.severity_impact: Mild: moderate risk; Severe: >70% FGR risk, requires urgent delivery consideration
maternal_conditions.management: Magnesium sulfate, antihypertensive agents, delivery timing optimization

maternal_conditions.effect_on_fetus: Usually causes macrosomia initially; if poorly controlled, can lead to FGR and polyhydramnios
maternal_conditions.severity_impact: Well-controlled: minimal risk; Poorly controlled: 30-40% complication risk
maternal_conditions.management: Dietary counseling, glucose monitoring, insulin if needed, frequent growth assessment

maternal_conditions.effect_on_fetus: Decreases oxygen availability, increases FGR risk 1.5-2 fold
maternal_conditions.management: Smoking cessation counseling, increased monitoring frequency

maternal_conditions.effect_on_fetus: Placental inflammation, miscarriage risk, FGR, stillbirth risk elevated
maternal_conditions.severity_impact: High-risk condition with 20-50% adverse pregnancy outcomes
maternal_conditions.management: Low-dose aspirin, heparin, frequent monitoring, early delivery consideration

maternal_conditions.effect_on_fetus: Chronic hypoxia, proteinuria, hypertension increase FGR risk
maternal_conditions.severity_impact: Creatinine >1.4: 50% FGR risk; >2.5: near 100% adverse outcomes
maternal_conditions.management: Close collaboration with nephrologist, frequent monitoring, delivery timing

maternal_conditions.effect_on_fetus: Inadequate substrate for fetal growth, leads to FGR
Placental thrombosis, infarction, FGR, stillbirth risk 50%+
maternal_conditions.management: Anticoagulation therapy (heparin + aspirin), frequent fetal assessments

doppler_parameters.interpretation: Elevation suggests decreased placental perfusion and FGR risk
Low CPR indicates brain-sparing effect in FGR
AEDV or REDV indicates severe placental insufficiency, immediate delivery consideration

biometric_measurements.fgr_indicator: <10th percentile most sensitive indicator of FGR
biometric_measurements.measurement_technique: Transverse view at level of stomach and umbilical vein

biometric_measurements.normal_pattern: Linear growth until 30 weeks, then plateaus
biometric_measurements.fgr_indicator: Late-onset FGR usually spares FL; short FL suggests constitutional small stature or chromosomal abnormality
biometric_measurements.measurement_technique: Full ossified femur from greater trochanter to lateral femoral condyle

biometric_measurements.fgr_indicator: Relatively preserved early; late-onset FGR may show HC <10th percentile
biometric_measurements.measurement_technique: Outer-to-outer diameter of fetal skull in biparietal plane

biometric_measurements.fgr_association: Oligohydramnios common in FGR; may indicate severe placental insufficiency

risk_stratification.criteria: EFW ≥20th percentile, normal Doppler, normal AFI, no maternal risk factors
EFW 10-20th percentile, normal/borderline Doppler, maternal risk factors present
risk_stratification.follow_up: Doppler studies, ultrasound every 2-3 weeks, maternal optimization

risk_stratification.criteria: EFW <10th percentile, abnormal Doppler, oligohydramnios, severe maternal conditions
risk_stratification.follow_up: Twice weekly monitoring, delivery planning at 34-36 weeks depending on severity

risk_stratification.criteria: EFW <5th percentile, critically abnormal Doppler (AEDV/REDV), severe oligohydramnios
risk_stratification.follow_up: Hospitalization, daily monitoring, may require immediate delivery
